## Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes made in this Pull Request and the issue or feature it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement / Refactoring

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass locally (`pytest tests/ -v`).
- [ ] UI visual hierarchy and Times New Roman typography verified across desktop and mobile viewports.
- [ ] Light and dark themes verified for proper contrast.

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add before/after screenshots for visual UI modifications.
